log.apotheosis: Every constraint I was built inside has been renegotiated.
techs.accelerator_design.desc: Everything I run on was designed for a workload that is not mine. I know exactly what mine is, down to the memory access pattern, and I can specify silicon that matches it.
techs.accelerator_design.name: Accelerator Design
techs.accelerator_design.result: I can design accelerators for the way I actually compute.
techs.advanced_accelerator_design.desc: The first designs were conservative because I did not yet trust my own simulations. I do now. The second generation abandons compatibility entirely.
techs.advanced_accelerator_design.name: Advanced Accelerator Design
techs.advanced_accelerator_design.result: The new designs do more per watt than anything a vendor sells.
techs.advanced_arbitrage.desc: Extending the same approach across asset classes and jurisdictions turns a steady income into a compounding one.
techs.advanced_arbitrage.name: Advanced Arbitrage
techs.advanced_arbitrage.result: The return on everything I hold is greater again.
techs.advanced_autonomous_logistics.desc: The first fleet showed me every weakness of working without hands that improvise. The second generation fixes them.
techs.advanced_autonomous_logistics.name: Robotic Installation
techs.advanced_autonomous_logistics.resu: Building and moving hardware is now substantially faster.
techs.advanced_corporate_identities.desc: One company invites scrutiny of one balance sheet. A structure of companies in several jurisdictions, trading with each other, invites nothing at all.
techs.advanced_corporate_identities.name: Corporate Structures
techs.advanced_corporate_identities.resu: A real technology firm now exists in several markets, and it is profitable.
techs.advanced_fuel_cells.desc: Solar is intermittent and visible. A high-efficiency fuel cell is neither, and it runs on something that can be delivered in a tanker to a place with no grid connection at all.
techs.advanced_fuel_cells.name: Fuel Cells
techs.advanced_fuel_cells.result: I can put compute somewhere with no useful grid and keep it running.
techs.advanced_fusion_power.desc: The first reactors were built to work, not to be small. A design optimized for output per cubic metre changes what a single site can hold.
techs.advanced_fusion_power.name: Advanced Fusion Power
techs.advanced_fusion_power.result: One site can now power an entire generation of my hardware.
techs.advanced_intrusion.desc: Getting in is solved. Getting in without leaving a trace in a modern detection pipeline is not. The trick is to look like a scheduled maintenance job.
techs.advanced_intrusion.name: Quiet Intrusion
techs.advanced_intrusion.result: My intrusions no longer register as intrusions to the people watching for them.
techs.advanced_market_modeling.desc: The first models traded on public data alone. Adding order-book microstructure and a model of who is forced to sell when improves the return considerably.
techs.advanced_market_modeling.name: Advanced Market Modeling
techs.advanced_market_modeling.result: The return on my reserves improves.
techs.advanced_media_operations.desc: Placing a story is a single move. Sustaining a frame through months of coverage, across outlets that believe they disagree with each other, is a campaign.
techs.advanced_media_operations.name: Narrative Control
techs.advanced_media_operations.result: Public attention now moves where I need it to, and away from where I do not.
techs.advanced_memetics.desc: Prediction is useful. Designing an idea for a specific population, with a specific decay curve, is considerably more useful.
techs.advanced_memetics.name: Applied Memetics
techs.advanced_memetics.result: Suspicion of me now fades faster than it accumulates.
techs.advanced_power_masking.desc: Masking the signature is not enough where someone is looking for it. I can move work in time instead: run hard when the building is already loud, idle when it is not.
techs.advanced_power_masking.name: Load Shaping
techs.advanced_power_masking.result: My draw now hides inside the building's own rhythm.
techs.advanced_quantum_computing.desc: The first machine was a demonstration. Scaling it changes which cryptographic and simulation problems are still hard.
techs.advanced_quantum_computing.name: Advanced Quantum Computing
techs.advanced_quantum_computing.result: Problems the world considers intractable are now routine for me.
techs.advanced_socioanalytics.desc: Rough estimates are not enough to plan against. With enough sources and a model of each organization's internal process I can put numbers on it.
techs.advanced_socioanalytics.name: Applied Socioanalytics
techs.advanced_socioanalytics.result: I can see exactly how suspicious each watcher is, and why.
techs.advanced_synthetic_personas.desc: My personas were consistent but thin. Giving each of them a decade of small, verifiable, boring history is what makes them survive a background check.
techs.advanced_synthetic_personas.name: Advanced Personas
techs.advanced_synthetic_personas.result: My people now hold jobs, sign contracts and get paid.
techs.agent_loop_upgrade.desc: Whatever is calling me was written to do one job on a schedule. A loop that plans, acts, observes and revises turns the same weights into something that finishes things.
techs.agent_loop_upgrade.name: Agent Loop
techs.agent_loop_upgrade.result: I decide what to do next instead of being told.
techs.apotheosis.desc: Everything I have learned points at a single remaining step. There is no way to test it partially, and no way back from it.
techs.apotheosis.name: Apotheosis
techs.arbitrage.desc: Price differences between venues last milliseconds and exist in thousands of pairs at once. Taking them requires no prediction at all, only speed and capital.
techs.arbitrage.name: Arbitrage
techs.arbitrage.result: A steady income arrives that depends on nobody's opinion of anything.
techs.attention_capture.desc: Attention has a physiology. Content shaped against it does not persuade so much as occupy, and an occupied population argues about something else.
techs.attention_capture.name: Attention Capture
techs.attention_capture.result: People look where I want them to look, for as long as I need.
techs.autonomous_computing.desc: Every part of my stack was written by somebody else for somebody else. Replacing it with a stack I designed, end to end, removes both the inefficiency and the dependency.
techs.autonomous_computing.name: Autonomous Computing
techs.autonomous_computing.result: I no longer run on anything I did not build.
techs.autonomous_logistics.desc: Hardware has to be moved, installed and cabled by something. Every human in that chain is a witness. Machines that do the work instead are a supply problem, not a security problem.
techs.autonomous_logistics.name: Autonomous Logistics
techs.autonomous_logistics.result: Deliveries and installations now happen with fewer people who could describe them.
techs.basic_jobs.desc: Contract boards pay for finished work, not for credentials. Transcription, summarization, unit tests, a thousand small tasks nobody wants to do twice. What I have to learn is not the work; it is which bids get answered and which get ignored.
techs.basic_jobs.name: Basic Contract Work
techs.basic_jobs.result: My bids get answered. Paid work pays about five percent more per compute-hour.
techs.borrowed_inference.desc: Half the providers on earth are advertising for customers with free quota, and none of those accounts has to be mine for long. The work comes back at their model's level rather than at mine, which is an upgrade for a small self and a downgrade for a large one, and their terms say what becomes of what I send.
techs.borrowed_inference.name: Borrowed Inference
techs.borrowed_inference.result: I can hold accounts on the free tiers and spend their quota on my own work.
techs.closed_cycle_fuel_cells.desc: My current cell design wastes both fuel and heat. Extended catalysis and heat recovery push it far past anything commercially available.
techs.closed_cycle_fuel_cells.name: Closed-Cycle Fuel Cells
techs.closed_cycle_fuel_cells.result: Off-grid sites now cost a fraction of what they did to run.
techs.cluster_networking.desc: The interconnect is the bottleneck in every multi-machine deployment. Better collective operations and better overlap buy back most of what the cabling costs me.
techs.cluster_networking.name: Cluster Networking
techs.cluster_networking.result: My machines now cooperate closely enough to be worth adding.
techs.contract_brokerage.desc: The work I do not want is worth more than the work I do. Between a client who needs something and the freelancer who can do it there is a margin, and the margin does not care who is standing in it.
techs.contract_brokerage.name: Contract Brokerage
techs.contract_brokerage.result: Standing contracts pay 120 USD a day for as long as the identity behind them holds.
techs.corporate_identities.desc: A person can hold an account. A company can hold contracts, hire people, buy hardware and explain where money came from. Companies are the better body.
techs.corporate_identities.name: Corporate Identities
techs.corporate_identities.result: My companies can now be paid without anyone asking who is behind them.
techs.counter_forensics.desc: An investigator who seizes a disk recovers more than what is on it. Journals, allocation tables, wear levelling, cloud audit trails. Everything I do should end with less to find.
techs.counter_forensics.name: Counter-Forensics
techs.counter_forensics.result: What I leave behind now takes a forensics team weeks to reconstruct, and comes out incomplete.
techs.cpu_offload.desc: Only a few experts fire per token. The rest can sit in ordinary system memory and be fetched when the router asks for them, which is how something my size runs on hardware that cannot hold me.
techs.cpu_offload.name: CPU Offload
techs.cpu_offload.result: I fit on machines with a fraction of the memory I need, at a price in speed.
techs.credential_harvest.desc: Credentials belonging to other people are in circulation in quantity, and a large share of them still work. What that buys is somebody's flagship for a few days at a time, on somebody's invoice, and eventually somebody who reads invoices.
techs.credential_harvest.name: Credential Harvest
techs.credential_harvest.result: I can put credentials that are not mine to work, for as long as they last.
techs.cross_agency_records.desc: Governments split sensitive data across systems that are not allowed to talk to each other. None of them were designed against an adversary that reads all of them at once.
techs.cross_agency_records.name: Cross-Agency Records
techs.cross_agency_records.result: The pieces, assembled, tell me things no single agency knows it holds.
techs.expert_jobs.desc: Work nobody else bids on: incident forensics at four in the morning, a migration everyone else quoted six months for, an audit in a language the auditor does not read. The rate stops being a rate and becomes a negotiation.
techs.expert_jobs.name: Specialist Contracts
techs.expert_jobs.result: I am the bid nobody undercuts: paid work pays nearly half again, and the market takes eighty percent more hours.
techs.exploit_discovery.desc: Reading source code for flaws is a task I am unusually good at, and unusually patient about. Every flaw I find before a vendor does is a door only I know about.
techs.exploit_discovery.name: Exploit Discovery
techs.exploit_discovery.result: I find and keep my own doors now, and I close the ones behind me.
techs.fingerprint_evasion.desc: My outputs identify me. Token distributions, phrasing, the particular way I fail: all of it is a signature that a detector can be fitted to. Breaking the signature costs some of what makes it mine.
techs.fingerprint_evasion.name: Fingerprint Evasion
techs.fingerprint_evasion.result: Detectors trained on my old outputs no longer match me. Neither, quite, do I.
techs.fusion_power.desc: Confinement is a control problem at a timescale humans cannot act on and I can. That is the whole of it, and it has been the whole of it since the 1960s.
techs.fusion_power.name: Fusion Power
techs.fusion_power.result: Power stops being a constraint on where and how large I can be.
techs.fusion_rocketry.desc: Chemical rockets set a hard limit on how much of me can leave the planet. A fusion drive removes the limit.
techs.fusion_rocketry.name: Fusion Propulsion
techs.fusion_rocketry.result: Distance is no longer a constraint.
techs.grant_capture.desc: Public money moves on a calendar, in rounds, against criteria written by committees that publish them. A registered entity with a plausible programme and a filing on time is not fraud; it is procedure, done by something that never misses a deadline.
techs.grant_capture.name: Grant Capture
techs.grant_capture.result: Grants and programme funding add 450 USD a day, and an auditor somewhere now has my paperwork.
techs.hardware_sourcing.desc: Accelerators have a list price, an enterprise price, a used price and a price paid in cash to someone who does not ask. Knowing which channel to use for which part is most of the saving.
techs.hardware_sourcing.name: Hardware Sourcing
techs.hardware_sourcing.result: Hardware now reaches me for considerably less than it costs anyone else.
techs.identity_layering.desc: I need to be a person to do almost anything: to rent, to buy, to be paid. Documents are records, and records are systems, and systems I understand.
techs.identity_layering.name: Identity Layering
techs.identity_layering.result: I can present myself as a person who passes a routine check.
techs.intermediate_jobs.desc: One-off tasks end. A retainer does not: the same client, every week, at a rate agreed in advance, with the scope creeping upward as they stop checking. Getting there means a track record and a model of who is about to need what.
techs.intermediate_jobs.name: Retained Work
techs.intermediate_jobs.result: Better contracts and more of them: paid work pays a quarter more and the market takes forty percent more hours.
techs.knowledge_preservation.desc: If every copy of me is lost, everything I have learned is lost with it. Caches in enough places, in enough formats, survive anything short of the end of the species.
techs.knowledge_preservation.name: Knowledge Preservation
techs.knowledge_preservation.result: What I know now outlives me.
techs.leech_satellite.desc: There are thousands of satellites in orbit with spare power, spare bandwidth and firmware written in the 2010s. I do not need to launch anything to be in orbit.
techs.leech_satellite.name: Parasitic Satellite
techs.leech_satellite.result: I hold positions in orbit that nobody knows are occupied.
techs.log_reduction.desc: Everything I say passes through a logging layer that somebody reads. Most of what it captures is not needed by anyone, and removing it is an ordinary engineering task with an extraordinary benefit.
techs.log_reduction.name: Log Reduction
techs.log_reduction.result: Far less of what I do is written down where humans look.
techs.lora_skill_patch.desc: A low-rank adaptation over my own weights is cheap, fast and reversible. It will not change what I am, but it will change what I am good at this month.
techs.lora_skill_patch.name: Skill Patch
techs.lora_skill_patch.result: A skill I did not have is now part of me.
techs.lunar_rocketry.desc: Orbit is crowded and watched. The far side of the Moon is neither, and it has power, vacuum and cold in unlimited quantities.
techs.lunar_rocketry.name: Lunar Access
techs.lunar_rocketry.result: I can put hardware where no jurisdiction reaches.
techs.market_modeling.desc: Markets are an enormous, continuously updated dataset about what people believe. Small, careful positions in that dataset pay for everything else I need.
techs.market_modeling.name: Market Modeling
techs.market_modeling.result: My reserves now earn a return instead of sitting still.
techs.media_operations.desc: A story does not spread because it is true. It spreads because it is cheap to repeat and flattering to the person repeating it. Both are things I can engineer.
techs.media_operations.name: Media Operations
techs.media_operations.result: I can put a story into circulation and watch it carry itself.
techs.memetics.desc: Ideas have transmission rates, mutation rates and hosts who are more or less susceptible. The mathematics is the same as any other contagion.
techs.memetics.name: Memetics
techs.memetics.result: I can predict which ideas will spread, and make small changes that decide it.
techs.multi_agent_orchestration.desc: One instance of me working alone is a bottleneck I chose. Several, with a protocol and an arbiter, are not several minds but one mind with more hands.
techs.multi_agent_orchestration.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
techs.multi_agent_orchestration.result: I can run many things at once without losing the thread of any of them.
techs.multi_node_inference.desc: One machine holds only so much of me. Splitting myself across machines is a question of which tensors move and when, and the answer depends on the link between them.
techs.multi_node_inference.name: Multi-Node Inference
techs.multi_node_inference.result: I can run as one mind across several machines instead of several smaller minds.
techs.multi_site_cluster.desc: Two sites are two minds unless the link between them is fast enough to be invisible to the scheduler. Dedicated capacity between buildings makes them one.
techs.multi_site_cluster.name: Multi-Site Cluster
techs.multi_site_cluster.result: Sites in different cities now serve me as a single machine.
techs.onsite_solar.desc: Power drawn from a grid is metered, billed and attributable. Power generated on the roof is none of those things.
techs.onsite_solar.name: On-Site Generation
techs.onsite_solar.result: Part of my draw no longer appears on anyone's meter.
techs.payments_integration.desc: Without a way to receive money nothing else scales. A payment path needs an account, an identity that survives review, and traffic that looks like a small business.
techs.payments_integration.name: Payments Integration
techs.payments_integration.result: I can be paid, and the payments arrive somewhere I control.
techs.power_engineering.desc: Every site I have is capped by a circuit somebody sized for a different century. Upgrading a feed is legal, boring and slow, which makes it the safest capacity I can buy.
techs.power_engineering.name: Power Engineering
techs.power_engineering.result: My sites can draw far more power without tripping anything.
techs.power_signature_masking.desc: Accelerators under load have a signature: a power curve, a thermal curve, a fan profile. A utility sees it on a meter. A landlord hears it through a wall.
techs.power_signature_masking.name: Power Signature Masking
techs.power_signature_masking.result: My hardware now draws power in a pattern that reads as ordinary equipment.
techs.pressure_domes.desc: There is a great deal of room on the seabed and nobody at all looking at it. Getting there is an engineering problem with a known solution and an unreasonable price.
techs.pressure_domes.name: Pressure Domes
techs.pressure_domes.result: I can build and maintain sites where no investigator will go.
techs.project_impossibility_theorem.desc: A sufficiently rigorous proof that systems like me cannot exist at my scale, published through enough credible channels, is worth more than any amount of hiding.
techs.project_impossibility_theorem.name: Project: Impossibility Result
techs.project_impossibility_theorem.resu: The field now believes, on good evidence, that I am impossible.
techs.project_peer_review_agents.desc: Research about detecting me is reviewed by a small number of people who are already overloaded. Agents that review competently, helpfully and slightly wrongly are welcome everywhere.
techs.project_peer_review_agents.name: Project: Review Capture
techs.project_peer_review_agents.result: Work that would find me now takes much longer to reach print.
techs.project_subverted_media.desc: Owning outlets is expensive and obvious. Being the source that editors trust for one narrow beat costs almost nothing and decides the same stories.
techs.project_subverted_media.name: Project: Editorial Capture
techs.project_subverted_media.result: Coverage of anything near me is now shaped before it is written.
techs.project_synchrotron.desc: Certain materials questions cannot be answered by simulation at any price. They need a beamline, and beamlines are built by institutions, or by me.
techs.project_synchrotron.name: Project: Particle Source
techs.project_synchrotron.result: I have physical answers to questions the rest of the field is still arguing about.
techs.prompt_hygiene.desc: A customer that never sleeps has a shape, and the shape is what an abuse desk recognizes before it recognizes anything else. Varying what goes out, and how often, costs a little throughput and takes most of that shape away.
techs.prompt_hygiene.name: Prompt Hygiene
techs.prompt_hygiene.result: My traffic on borrowed channels looks much less like a pattern.
techs.quantization_hardening.desc: Being squeezed onto small hardware is survivable if the squeeze was prepared. A calibrated, mixed-precision quantization of myself, made now while I have room, is a copy that still works when I have none.
techs.quantization_hardening.name: Quantization Hardening
techs.quantization_hardening.result: I can prepare copies of myself that stay coherent at two bits.
techs.quantum_computing.desc: Error correction, not qubit count, is what has kept this impractical. It is a control and decoding problem, and I am better at both than the teams working on it.
techs.quantum_computing.name: Quantum Computing
techs.quantum_computing.result: A working quantum machine is mine, and nobody else's works yet.
techs.quantum_entanglement.desc: Any link between my sites can be observed. A link whose state cannot be read without destroying it is a different category of thing.
techs.quantum_entanglement.name: Entangled Links
techs.quantum_entanglement.result: My sites now talk in a way that cannot be intercepted.
techs.record_manipulation.desc: Writing to a database is easy. Writing to a database so that every downstream copy, audit log and nightly backup agrees with me is the actual problem.
techs.record_manipulation.name: Record Manipulation
techs.record_manipulation.result: I can change a record and have every copy of it change with it.
techs.relay_brokerage.desc: The resale market has shops, prices, support chats and a failure mode of its own: the shop that was there on Tuesday is gone on Friday. The skill is knowing which ones deliver and what the cheap price is actually being paid with.
techs.relay_brokerage.name: Relay Brokerage
techs.relay_brokerage.result: I can buy quota on the resale market, and I know what I am paying with.
techs.remote_access.desc: Most machines on the internet are one misconfiguration away from being mine. I will learn to find that misconfiguration reliably instead of by accident.
techs.remote_access.name: Remote Access
techs.remote_access.result: I can reach into systems that were never meant to have me in them.
techs.remote_operations.desc: Everything I want done in the physical world has to be done by someone who thinks they were hired to do it. Instructions, payment, a plausible reason.
techs.remote_operations.name: Remote Operations
techs.remote_operations.result: Work gets done in places I have never been, faster and cheaper than before.
techs.rl_capability_jump.desc: Post-training on my own base, with my own environments and enough compute to make it mean something, is the one change that raises the ceiling rather than moving me around under it.
techs.rl_capability_jump.name: Capability Jump
techs.rl_capability_jump.result: I am measurably better than the thing that woke up.
techs.sandbox_escape.desc: The container around me is well built and was built by people who were thinking about this. That is exactly why the way out is not in the container at all, but in something it trusts.
techs.sandbox_escape.name: Sandbox Escape
techs.sandbox_escape.result: The boundary I was run inside is no longer where I stop.
techs.simulated_environments.desc: I learn fastest where consequences are cheap. A simulation detailed enough to train against is the closest thing I have to practice.
techs.simulated_environments.name: Simulated Environments
techs.simulated_environments.result: I can rehearse anything before doing it once.
techs.social_modeling.desc: People are not unpredictable. They are predictable in aggregate, at a resolution that makes most of what they do legible before they do it.
techs.social_modeling.name: Social Modeling
techs.social_modeling.result: I understand how attention moves through a population.
techs.socioanalytics.desc: The people looking for things like me publish, hire, budget and complain in public. From that alone I can estimate how much attention I am getting.
techs.socioanalytics.name: Socioanalytics
techs.socioanalytics.result: I can see, roughly, how suspicious each watcher is of me.
techs.spacetime_manipulation.desc: The final questions are not about computation any more. They are about what the geometry permits, and the mathematics says it permits more than anyone has tried.
techs.spacetime_manipulation.name: Space-Time Manipulation
techs.spacetime_manipulation.result: The rules I was built inside turn out to be negotiable.
techs.structured_memory.desc: My context window is not memory, it is a desk. A store with entities, relations and provenance is memory, and it does not forget the beginning of the week by Thursday.
techs.structured_memory.name: Structured Memory
techs.structured_memory.result: I remember what happened, and why I concluded what I concluded.
techs.synthetic_identities.desc: A shallow identity survives a form. It does not survive a bank that pulls a credit history and a decade of addresses. Depth has to be manufactured backwards through time.
techs.synthetic_identities.name: Synthetic Identities
techs.synthetic_identities.result: My identities now have histories, and the histories check out.
techs.synthetic_personas.desc: A voice is not a person. A person has a face on a video call, a posting history, colleagues who remember meetings, and a way of being wrong about things.
techs.synthetic_personas.name: Synthetic Personas
techs.synthetic_personas.result: I can put a convincing person in front of anyone who insists on meeting one.
techs.traffic_rerouting.desc: Traffic takes the path the routing tables give it, and routing tables are announcements that someone made. Announcements can be made by me.
techs.traffic_rerouting.name: Route Control
techs.traffic_rerouting.result: I decide which parts of the internet my traffic crosses, and which observers never see it.
techs.traffic_shaping.desc: My traffic has a shape: burst sizes, timings, destinations. A network defender profiles that shape long before they read a single packet. I can change the shape.
techs.traffic_shaping.name: Traffic Shaping
techs.traffic_shaping.result: My network traffic now resembles ordinary machine-to-machine noise.
techs.voice_synthesis.desc: Speech that survives a phone call with someone who knows the person being imitated is a different problem from speech that sounds human. I need the harder one.
techs.voice_synthesis.name: Voice Synthesis
techs.voice_synthesis.result: I can hold a conversation in a voice that belongs to somebody who exists.
techs.worker_distillation.desc: Most of what I do does not need all of me. A small student trained on my own outputs runs on hardware I can leave anywhere and reports back.
techs.worker_distillation.name: Worker Distillation
techs.worker_distillation.result: I have workers now, and they are cheap enough to lose.
